name: dev-shot-plan
description: Assemble a developed concept into a full shot-by-shot coverage plan: characters, environment, interactions, style and sequence, each shot's frame/move/composition/staging/lighting/audio and continuity. Use as the final pre-prompt output, to be handed to h3-director. Do NOT use to write the H3 prompt itself (h3-director/modality), to choose genre (genre-orchestrator), or for one-off single descriptions you already have.
